description:
Create a draft version by reverting to a previous version's config.
Copies components, config, and pricing from the target version. If a draft already exists, updates it in-place (single-draft rule).

Use `stackversions` first to find available version numbers.

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...), version (target version number).

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

version.description: Target stack version number to roll back to. Use stackversions to list available versions.

name: stackrollback

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

version.description: The stack version the session now points to (version, status).

title: Rollback Stack Version
